description: Prepare a link to review and save a tee-time alert on asap.golf. This does not create or activate an alert. The golfer must open the link, sign in, review and save it, and connect a notification method to receive alerts. Use course IDs returned by search.

courseIds.description: Connected course IDs in the selected region.

days.description: Number of dates for a one-time alert; default 1.

from.description: Earliest local tee time, minutes after midnight.

region.description: Supported region ID returned by search.

startDate.description: First date in YYYY-MM-DD, in the region’s local time.

to.description: Latest local tee time, minutes after midnight.

weekdays.description: Days to repeat: Sunday is 0. Required for weekly alerts.

name: prepare_alert
